content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

Stripe and PayPal may dominate the payment processing landscape, but they operate in only 46 countries, leaving vast regions underserved. Their offerings include user-friendly interfaces, quick setup, and customer support. However, these benefits come at the cost of accessibility. For those excluded, alternatives like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack provide a fully functional digital storefront without the restrictions. With no dependency on third-party platforms, creators can sell their fonts directly to customers worldwide.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have strict geographical limitations, which often leads to creators in countries like Nigeria and Pakistan being locked out of the global digital marketplace. PayPal suspensions can hold funds for up to 180 days, leaving sellers unable to access their earnings. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, enables creators in these restricted regions to own and operate their digital stores independently. This guarantees that they can accept payments without the fear of sudden account freezes or platform bans.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While Stripe and PayPal tout fast payment processing, creators in excluded countries may wait indefinitely to receive funds. Both platforms charge transaction fees that can eat into profits, and unexpected holds can disrupt cash flow. The Edge Commerce Stack offers a transparent fee structure with NOWPayments, charging only a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. Payments are processed almost instantly in over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that creators can access their funds as soon as the transaction is confirmed on-chain.
OWN your digital storefront; don't rent it.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical aspect that Stripe and PayPal do not provide. When using these platforms, creators do not own their data or the infrastructure that powers their stores. In contrast, with the Edge Commerce Stack, creators have complete ownership and control over their digital products and customer data. The system automates payment processing and file delivery, meaning once a sale is made, customers receive their fonts instantly without the creator needing to intervene. This level of automation frees up time for creators to focus on new projects.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and situation. If you operate in a restricted region and need a robust, dependable solution, the Edge Commerce Stack is the way to go. It features Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase for order management, and NOWPayments for payment processing, all configured for optimal performance. If you're just starting and want a basic setup, consider a simpler solution, but know it may lack the full capabilities of the Edge Commerce Stack.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Unlock global sales without the limitations of Stripe or PayPal.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
